author: By Satya Rhodes-Conway | guest column
title: Opinion | Mayor: Lawsuit misrepresents Madison's election policies
text: Satya Rhodes-Conway: The lawsuit seeks to divert city resources from public services. Our response does not reflect a lack of commitment to voters' rights.
